data.name: Section1Title
data.value: Core Evaluation Principles

data.name: Section1Subtitle
data.value: The review process requires an impartial, confidential, and scientific evaluation approach.

data.name: ConfidentialityText
data.value: Confidentiality and impartiality

data.name: Section1Text_Part1
data.value: Submission content presented to you during the review process is confidential.

data.name: Section1Text_Strong
data.value: Submission files, author information, and review notes must not be shared with third parties.

data.name: Section1Text_Part2
data.value: If you believe there is a conflict of interest, you are expected to return the review assignment.

data.name: Section2Title
data.value: Evaluation Criteria

data.name: Section2Subtitle
data.value: You may consider the following main headings when evaluating a submission.

data.name: Criterion1Title
data.value: Originality and Contribution

data.name: Criterion1Text
data.value: The innovation and contribution of the work to the literature, practice, or relevant field should be evaluated.

data.name: Criterion2Title
data.value: Methodology and Scientific Consistency

data.name: Criterion2Text
data.value: The scientific consistency of the method, data, analysis, and conclusions should be examined.

data.name: Criterion3Title
data.value: Presentation and Writing Quality

data.name: Criterion3Text
data.value: The abstract language, academic expression, structure, clarity, and references should be evaluated.

data.name: Criterion4Title
data.value: Ethical Compliance

data.name: Criterion4Text
data.value: Compliance with ethical principles, academic integrity, and impartial evaluation rules should be considered.

data.name: DecisionGuideTitle
data.value: Decision Recommendations

data.name: DecisionGuideSubtitle
data.value: The decision recommendation you provide at the end of the evaluation has the following meanings.

data.name: DecisionAccept
data.value: Accept

data.name: DecisionAcceptText
data.value: The submission can be included in the scientific program as is.

data.name: DecisionMinorRevision
data.value: Minor Revision

data.name: DecisionMinorRevisionText
data.value: The submission may be acceptable with minor corrections.

data.name: DecisionMajorRevision
data.value: Major Revision

data.name: DecisionMajorRevisionText
data.value: The submission requires extensive revision; re-evaluation may be needed.

data.name: DecisionReject
data.value: Reject

data.name: DecisionRejectText
data.value: The submission may not be considered sufficient for inclusion in the scientific program.

data.name: EthicsTitle
data.value: Ethics and Confidentiality Rules

data.name: EthicsSubtitle
data.value: The following rules must be observed during the review process.

data.name: EthicsItem1
data.value: Do not share submission content with third parties.

data.name: EthicsItem2
data.value: Do not contact the author directly.

data.name: EthicsItem3
data.value: Return the assignment if there is a conflict of interest.

data.name: EthicsItem4
data.value: Write your comments in a constructive and academic tone.

data.name: SupportTitle
data.value: Additional Information

data.name: SupportText
data.value: If you encounter any issues during the review process, you may contact the conference management.
